questions.explanation: 'Ask to speak to someone' = yêu cầu được nói chuyện với ai. → (D)
questions.hint: 'ask ------- to Coleman Cobb' -> CUM DONG TU. 'Ask to speak to someone' = yeu cau duoc noi chuyen. 'to speak' = dong tu nguyen mau.

questions.text: ------- [sentence insertion after asking to speak to delivery manager]
options: (A) He can schedule a convenient time.
(C) He can meet you at 11:00 A.M.
questions.explanation: Sau khi yêu cầu nói chuyện với quản lý giao hàng → câu tiếp theo nên đề cập đến việc lên lịch giao hàng tiện lợi. → (A)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau nay den sau 'ask to speak to... delivery manager'. Cau tiep theo nen noi ve viec quan ly giao hang co the lam gi? -> Len lich giao hang tien loi.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Keep Cool Service Contractors (Câu 135-138)
questions.text: Keep Cool Service Contractors can bring you peace of mind. As part of an annual contract, we will service your air-conditioning system, ensuring your ------- and comfort.
questions.explanation: 'Ensuring your safety and comfort' = đảm bảo sự an toàn. Danh từ sau tính từ sở hữu 'your'. → (D)
questions.hint: 'ensuring your ------- and comfort' -> DANH TU song song voi 'comfort'. 'Safety and comfort' = an toan va thoai mai.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Keep Cool Service Contractors (Câu 135-138)
questions.text: This includes inspecting the system, making repairs as needed, and professionally cleaning your air ducts. -------, if necessary, we can replace your old air-conditioning system.
questions.explanation: 'Furthermore' = hơn nữa, thêm vào đó (liên từ chuyển ý bổ sung). → (C)
questions.hint: O trong dau cau: '-------, if necessary, we can replace...' -> CUM NOI KET CHUYEN Y bo sung. 'Furthermore' = hon nua.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Keep Cool Service Contractors (Câu 135-138)
questions.text: ------- [sentence insertion]. We promise you fair prices and professional work, backed by our Keep Cool guarantee.
options: (A) Take advantage of dozens of useful online tools.
(B) Moreover, the air conditioner you chose is very popular.
(C) Plus, they are friendly, clean, and knowledgeable.
(D) Thank you for visiting our contractor showroom.
questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo đề cập đến 'we promise fair prices' → câu insert phải nói về đặc điểm của nhân viên. 'Plus, they are friendly, clean, and knowledgeable.' → (C)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau tiep theo la 'We promise you fair prices and professional work'. Cau insert phai noi ve tinh cach nhan vien (than thien, gon gang, giau kien thuc) -> (C).

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 2: Keep Cool Service Contractors (Câu 135-138)
questions.text: We promise you fair prices and professional work, ------- by our Keep Cool guarantee.
questions.explanation: 'Backed by our guarantee' = được bảo đảm bởi (phân từ quá khứ dùng bị động). → (A)
questions.hint: 'professional work, ------- by our Keep Cool guarantee' -> PHAN TU QUA KHU lam tinh tu. 'Backed by' = duoc bao dam boi.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Light Idea Price Increase Notice (Câu 139-142)
questions.text: Light Idea is enacting a price increase on select energy-efficient products, effective April 17. Specific product pricing will -------.
questions.explanation: 'Specific product pricing will vary' = giá cụ thể sẽ khác nhau. → (B)
questions.hint: 'Specific product pricing will -------' -> DONG TU dien ta su thay doi. Gia san pham se 'thay doi' -> 'vary'.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Light Idea Price Increase Notice (Câu 139-142)
questions.text: All orders ------- after this date will follow the new price list.
questions.explanation: 'Orders received after this date' = đơn hàng nhận sau ngày này (phân từ quá khứ rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ). → (C)
questions.hint: 'All orders ------- after this date' -> PHAN TU rut gon menh de quan he. Don hang 'duoc nhan' sau ngay do -> Past Participle.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Light Idea Price Increase Notice (Câu 139-142)
questions.text: -------. Customers will be able to find this on our Web site.
options: (A) The updated price list will be available on March 20.
(C) Your orders will be shipped after April 17.
(D) We are increasing prices because of rising costs.
questions.explanation: Câu kế tiếp: 'Customers will find this on Web site' → 'this' ám chỉ bảng giá mới. Câu insert phải thông báo khi nào có bảng giá → (A)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau tiep theo 'Customers will be able to find this on our Web site'. 'this' am chi gi? -> Bang gia moi. Cau insert phai cho biet khi nao co bang gia moi.

questions.passageTitle: Part 6 - Passage 3: Light Idea Price Increase Notice (Câu 139-142)
questions.text: We will continue to provide quality products and ------- service to our valued customers.
questions.explanation: 'Exceptional service' = dịch vụ xuất sắc (tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'service'). → (C)
questions.hint: 'quality products and ------- service' -> TINH TU bo nghia cho 'service'. 'Exceptional service' = dich vu xuat sac.

questions.text: Thank you for the shipment last month of 80 units of your jewelry pieces. I am happy to report that they have been selling very well in my shop. My ------- love the colourful designs as well as the quality of your workmanship.
questions.explanation: Người mua hàng ở shop → 'customers'. → (C)
questions.hint: 'My ------- love the colourful designs' -> DANH TU chi nguoi mua hang tai cua hang. Ai yeu thich san pham cua ban ban?

questions.text: ------- [sentence insertion after 'customers love the designs and quality'].
options: (A) If you need more time, please let me know.
(B) Unfortunately, I do not have adequate shelf space at this time.
(C) I would like to show you some of my own designs.
(D) The reasonable prices also make your pieces a great value.
questions.explanation: Câu tiếp đề cập tăng số lượng đặt hàng → câu insert bổ sung thêm lý do khách thích (giá hợp lý). → (D)
questions.hint: SENTENCE INSERTION: cau tiep theo la 'Would you be able to double my order?' -> Truoc khi yeu cau tang don hang, nguoi viet nen them LY DO/KET QUA nua. Ly do la gi? -> Gia hop ly.

questions.text: I would like to increase the number of units I order from you. Would you be able to ------- my order for the September shipment?
questions.explanation: 'Double my order' = tăng gấp đôi đơn hàng. → (B)
questions.hint: 'Would you be able to ------- my order?' -> DONG TU co nghia tang gap doi. 'Double' = tang gap doi.

questions.text: I believe that I could reach your target audience best and that the agreement would serve ------- both very well.
questions.explanation: Tân ngữ gián tiếp của 'serve': 'serve us both' = phục vụ cho cả hai chúng ta. Người viết thư = 'us'. → (A)
questions.hint: 'the agreement would serve ------- both very well' -> DAI TU TAM NGU. Nguoi viet = Kenneth Okim + nguoi nhan = Jang-Ho -> 'us' = chung ta (ca hai).

part7.name: Part 7 - Reading Comprehension
part7.description: Doc cac doan van va tra loi cau hoi lien quan.

questions.text: What is true about the Savan Business Center?
options: (C) It recently launched a new Web site.
(D) It is seeking suggestions for webinar topics.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'The Savan Business Center offers support for business owners' → làm việc với doanh nghiệp nhỏ. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS TRUE ABOUT Savan Business Center? -> Scan tim thong tin ve to chuc nay. Doan 1: 'offers support for business owners' -> lam viec voi loai doanh nghiep nao?

questions.text: What is indicated about the webinar?
options: (B) It features advice on creating promotional content.
(C) It is being offered every month.
(D) It requires a small fee to attend.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'topics related to making your business stand out' = nội dung về quảng bá. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi ve WEBINAR: Scan tim thong tin ve 'webinar, Focus Your Social Media Presence'. Noi dung webinar la gi? -> 'topics related to making your business stand out'.

questions.text: What is mentioned about Dine Out Darville?
options: (B) It is held in a different location each year.
(C) It is being held for the first time.
(D) It includes both lunch and dinner.
questions.explanation: Câu đầu: 'which runs this year from June 22 to 28' = 7 ngày = một tuần. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS MENTIONED ABOUT Dine Out Darville? -> Tim cac thong tin duoc neu ro trong thong bao. 'June 22 to 28' = bao nhieu ngay?

questions.text: What is NOT included in the reduced-price meals?
questions.explanation: 'A four-course dinner including a cup of soup, a salad, a main course, and a dessert' → 'beverage' (đồ uống) không có trong danh sách. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: NOT INCLUDED -> Tim danh sach mon an trong 'four-course dinner'. Mon khong co trong danh sach la dap an.

questions.text: What does Rainsy LLC do?
options: (A) It stores and analyzes consumer information.
(C) It processes credit card payments for retailers.
questions.explanation: 'A data storage and analytics firm... helps businesses manage and understand their customer data' → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DOES RAINSY LLC DO? -> Scan tim mo ta dich vu: 'data storage and analytics firm'. Ho giup khach hang lam gi?

questions.text: Who will be based in Dade?
questions.explanation: 'approximately 50 percent of the company's workforce' = khoảng một nửa nhân viên. → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHO WILL BE BASED IN DADE? -> Tim cau co 'Dade location', 'work there', 'relocate'. Bao nhieu phan tram nhan vien chuyen den Dade?

questions.text: What is suggested about the paper Mr. Liu is shopping for?
options: (C) It is sold exclusively at Biz Plus.
questions.explanation: Jana nói 'I really need blue' → paper hiện ra của mình là màu xanh nhạt. Các màu khác tại Biz Plus là yellow, green, pink → paper bà cần màu xanh dương. Đây là hàng hết hàng tại Biz Plus. Nhưng xét kỹ: paper bà cần = light blue (vì bà nói 'I really need blue'). → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS SUGGESTED ABOUT PAPER? -> Doc tin nhan Jana Bhat: 'I really need blue'. Biz Plus co mau xanh khong? -> Het hang mau xanh nhat ma ba can.

questions.text: At 9:49 A.M., what does Ms. Bhat most likely mean when she writes, 'OK, forget it'?
options: (A) She wants to check her budget.
(B) She thinks Mr. Liu should not purchase paper at Biz Plus.
(C) She believes Mr. Liu should not place an order this week.
(D) She plans to cancel her order.
questions.explanation: Sau khi biết màu xanh khác đắt hơn → 'OK, forget it. I'll place an order online' = bỏ qua Biz Plus, tự đặt hàng online. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi ve 'OK, forget it' luc 9:49: Doc tin nhan ngay truoc do. Michael noi gi ve mau xanh khac? Jana quyet dinh lam gi? -> 'I'll place an order online'.

questions.text: Why did Ms. Otney write the letter?
options: (A) To welcome a new library director
(B) To register for an SFMA finance course
(D) To reply to a question from Mr. Croft
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu: 'I have read your inquiry about offering financial management courses' → đây là thư trả lời. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHY DID MS. OTNEY WRITE? -> Doc cau mo dau: 'I have read your inquiry about...' -> Day la thu PHAN HOI yeu cau cua ai?

questions.text: What is one thing Ms. Otney requested?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'If you have a list of library branches that would host the first series of events...' → yêu cầu danh sách địa điểm thư viện. → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DID MS. OTNEY REQUEST? -> Scan tim doan co 'If you have a list...' hoac 'Could you provide...'

questions.text: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? 'This is something I would be happy to arrange.'
questions.explanation: Câu insert: 'happy to arrange' = sẵn lòng sắp xếp → đứng sau đề xuất về việc SFMA members lead courses ([2]). → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi INSERTION: 'This is something I would be happy to arrange.' -> 'This' am chi hanh dong gi? -> Sap xep gi do (facilitators, courses). Tim vi tri de cau nay ket noi tu nhien.

questions.text: Why most likely was the advertisement created?
options: (A) To draw attention to an underused professional service
(B) To publicize the benefits of a warranty policy
(C) To announce the opening of new store locations
(D) To promote a temporary price discount
questions.explanation: '50% off all eyeglass frames through 30 September' = giảm giá tạm thời. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: PURPOSE OF ADVERTISEMENT? -> Tim uu dai chinh: '50% off through 30 September'. Day la loai quang cao nao?

questions.text: What is stated about Claro Vision stores?
options: (A) They are larger than competitors' stores.
(B) They accept all major credit cards.
(C) They are located next to shopping malls.
(D) They provide eyeglass fittings at no cost.
questions.explanation: 'Free eyeglass fittings and adjustments' = không tính tiền. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS STATED ABOUT CLARO VISION STORES? -> Doc danh sach 'advantages': 'Free eyeglass fittings and adjustments' -> Co tinh phi khong?

questions.text: What is stated about vision checkups?
options: (A) They are completed by a partner company.
(B) They are performed by a certified professional.
(C) They should be done every ten months.
(D) They are offered on a limited number of days.
questions.explanation: 'Low-cost vision checkups by licensed opticians' = do chuyên gia có giấy phép thực hiện. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi ve VISION CHECKUPS: Tim cau co 'vision checkups'. Ai thuc hien? -> 'licensed opticians' = chuyen gia co giay phep.

questions.text: What is the purpose of the letter?
options: (A) To explain the fees for equipment installation
(B) To offer a discount on a service
(C) To provide information about a lease agreement
(D) To request a change to a property amenity
questions.explanation: 'This is a reminder that the one-year lease for your space will end on 30 April' → cung cấp thông tin về hợp đồng thuê. → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: PURPOSE OF LETTER? -> Doc chu de thu: lenh nho ve hop dong thue sap het han. Muc dich chinh la gi?

questions.text: According to the letter, what must Ms. Balakrishnan pay for each month?
questions.explanation: Bảng phí: 'Parking space fee S$50.00' = phí đỗ xe hàng tháng. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT MUST MS. BALAKRISHNAN PAY EACH MONTH? -> Xem bang phi. Tim khoan phi hang thang. 'Parking space fee' = phi do xe.

questions.text: Who most likely is Ms. Tan?
questions.explanation: 'Please contact my office at 1555 0124 to make an appointment to renew your lease' → Ms. Tan là người quản lý bất động sản. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHO IS MS. TAN? -> Tim cau co 'Contact my office'. Nguoi co van phong de dat lich gia han hop dong thue la ai?

questions.text: Why did Mr. Hagel write the e-mail?
options: (A) To report damage to an item
questions.explanation: 'Thank you for forwarding your proposed revisions to the contract... I am out of the office... would you be available to meet?' → đàm phán hợp đồng. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHY DID MR. HAGEL WRITE? -> Doc chu de email: 'Your proposed changes'. Ong ay dang phan hoi ve dieu gi? -> Sua doi hop dong.

questions.text: What is indicated about Qualiview Ltd.?
options: (C) It has paid penalty fees in the past.
(D) It recently redesigned its shipping crates.
questions.explanation: 'contract for Qualiview Ltd. to be your wholesale supplier of automotive window glass' = làm kính ô tô. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS INDICATED ABOUT QUALIVIEW? -> Tim cau mo ta san pham/dich vu: 'wholesale supplier of automotive window glass'.

questions.text: The word 'address' in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'I am not sure what more we can do to address your concerns' = address = giải quyết/phản hồi. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi TU VUNG: 'address' trong doan 2. Doc nguyen cau: 'what more we can do to address your concerns'. 'Address concerns' = giai quyet moi quan ngai.

questions.text: When is Mr. Hagel available next week?
questions.explanation: 'I will be out of the office through Tuesday afternoon. Would you be available to meet before 11:00 A.M. on either Wednesday or Thursday?' → Thứ Tư buổi sáng (trước 11:00 A.M.). → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHEN IS MR. HAGEL AVAILABLE? -> Tim cau 'I will be out of the office through... Would you be available before 11:00 A.M. on either Wednesday or Thursday?' -> Ong ay ranh khi nao?

questions.text: What is mentioned about shipping containers?
options: (C) They are made from a variety of materials.
(D) They can be used for long-term storage.
questions.explanation: 'The demand for international freight space has been outpacing the availability of shipping containers' → khan hiếm. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS MENTIONED ABOUT SHIPPING CONTAINERS? -> Doan 1: 'demand has been outpacing the availability' -> tinh trang khan hiem. Dap an nao mo ta tinh trang nay?

questions.text: What does Mr. Lam say is needed to resolve the situation?
options: (A) A sharp increase in the number of customers
questions.explanation: 'It's going to take total cooperation of all stakeholders' = hợp tác giữa các bên liên quan. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DOES MR. LAM SAY IS NEEDED? -> Tim trich dan cua 'Henry Lam, a spokesperson'. Ong noi can gi de giai quyet?

questions.text: What type of clothing does Fezker produce?
questions.explanation: 'Fezker, the producer of athletic apparel and footwear' = quần áo thể thao. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DOES FEZKER PRODUCE? -> Tim cau mo ta Fezker: 'producer of athletic apparel and footwear' = quan ao/giay the thao.

questions.text: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? 'These markets are supplied using more readily available truck and train transportation.'
questions.explanation: Câu nói về phương tiện vận chuyển thay thế trong thị trường nội địa/khu vực → đứng sau đoạn đề cập Fezker chuyển sang thị trường nội địa [4]. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi INSERTION: 'These markets are supplied using more readily available truck and train transportation.' -> 'These markets' am chi thi truong nao? -> Thi truong noi dia va khu vuc (sau khi Fezker chuyen huong). Tim vi tri sau doan do.

questions.text: In what industry do the writers most likely work?
questions.explanation: Đề cập 'concrete finisher', 'Phase B of the Palisade project', 'pour the concrete' → ngành xây dựng. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT INDUSTRY? -> Tim tu khoa: 'concrete finisher', 'Phase B', 'pour the concrete', 'building materials' -> Nganh nao su dung nhung tu nay?

questions.text: Why did Mr. Wendel begin the discussion?
options: (C) To obtain an update on some work
(D) To change the start date of an event
questions.explanation: 'Can you share the current status of your projects?' = cập nhật tiến độ công việc. → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHY DID MR. WENDEL BEGIN? -> Tin nhan dau tien: 'Can you share the current status of your projects?' -> Muc dich la gi?

questions.text: What is indicated about the Riverview project?
options: (B) It is being managed by Ms. Yu.
(C) It will be completed in November.
(D) Its clients are happy with the progress.
questions.explanation: 'The rain last week delayed pouring the concrete... The Riverview project is already behind schedule because of equipment problems and late delivery of building materials' → nhiều lần trễ. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS INDICATED ABOUT RIVERVIEW? -> Tim thong tin ve du an nay: 'rain last week delayed', 'behind schedule', 'equipment problems and late delivery'. Du an co van de gi?

questions.text: At 7:58 A.M., what does Mr. Zuniga most likely mean when he writes, 'Will do'?
options: (A) He will revise a delivery schedule.
(C) He will hire workers to help at a site.
(D) He will share the outcome of a meeting.
questions.explanation: Mr. Wendel: 'Keep me posted'... Mr. Zuniga: 'Actually, I'm meeting Nathan at the site this morning... 'Will do'' = sẽ thông báo sau cuộc gặp. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi ve 'Will do' luc 7:58: Mr. Wendel vua yeu cau gi? -> 'Keep me posted' = thong bao cho toi biet. Mr. Zuniga se lam gi? -> Thong bao ket qua cuoc gap.

questions.text: What does the e-mail indicate about Karabel Industries ice cream?
options: (A) It is currently sold in four flavors.
(B) Its coloring can be changed easily.
(D) It is sold in Karabel Industries stores.
questions.explanation: 'we can easily adjust that in the laboratory' = có thể thay đổi màu sắc dễ dàng. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DOES E-MAIL INDICATE ABOUT KARABEL ICE CREAM? -> Tim cau co 'we can easily adjust' hoac mo ta dac diem san pham co the thay doi.

questions.text: What does Ms. Kerluke state that she wants to do?
questions.explanation: 'I would like to meet at 9 A.M. on Monday... to figure out how to proceed' = tổ chức cuộc họp nhóm. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT DOES MS. KERLUKE WANT TO DO? -> Doc doan cuoi: 'I would like to meet at 9 A.M. on Monday...to figure out how to proceed' -> Muon lam gi?

questions.text: What is suggested about Fatior Labs?
options: (C) It will perform another taste test for Karabel Industries.
(D) It supplies ice cream to Preston Grocers.
questions.explanation: 'We will also need to get some new flavours to Fatior Labs no later than 1 March' → sẽ thực hiện thêm thử nghiệm hương vị. → (C)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT IS SUGGESTED ABOUT FATIOR LABS? -> Tim cau co 'Fatior Labs' trong email. 'We will also need to get some new flavours to Fatior Labs' -> Ho se lam gi?

questions.text: Based on the survey form, what flavor will Karabel Industries most likely make adjustments to?
questions.explanation: Email: 'none of them received high enough ratings' nhưng đặc biệt đề cập 'colour in testing phase' → Lemon score Colour = 4 nhưng Taste = 2. Ms. Kerluke lo ngại về Taste < 3 → Lemon, Salted Caramel. Nhưng email nói 'best' là Peanut Brittle → loại trừ. Lemon Taste = 2 thấp nhất → cần điều chỉnh nhất. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT FLAVOR WILL BE ADJUSTED? -> Xem email: lo ngai ve vi nao? Xem bang khao sat: hang nao co diem Taste thap nhat (< 3)? -> Lemon = 2.

questions.text: What can be concluded about participant number 54?
options: (A) The participant purchased several containers of ice cream.
(B) The participant is between the ages of 25 and 40.
(C) The participant regularly takes consumer surveys.
(D) The participant prefers fruit-flavored ice cream.
questions.explanation: Email: 'our target market of consumers ages 25 through 40' + participant số 54 là khách hàng mục tiêu → 25-40 tuổi. → (B)
questions.hint: Cau hoi ve PARTICIPANT 54: Email noi gi ve doi tuong khao sat? -> 'target market of consumers ages 25 through 40'. Participant 54 thuoc nhom nao?

questions.text: According to the Web page, what will the job recipient be able to do?
questions.explanation: 'remote work is permitted for copywriters, residence in Canada is not required' → có thể làm việc từ xa. → (A)
questions.hint: Cau hoi: WHAT CAN JOB RECIPIENT DO? -> Tim dieu kien cua cong viec: 'remote work is permitted... residence in Canada is not required' -> Lam duoc gi?

questions.text: On the Web page, the word 'suit' in paragraph 2, line 4, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'brand strategies that suit customer needs' = phù hợp/thỏa mãn nhu cầu. 'Satisfy' = đáp ứng. → (D)
questions.hint: Cau hoi TU VUNG: 'suit' trong doan 2, dong 4. Doc cau: 'brand strategies that suit customer needs'. 'Suit' = phu hop/thoa man.

questions.text: What is indicated about Ms. Smith?
options: (A) She has already met Ms. Benjamin.
(B) She has worked as a copywriter.
(D) She forgot to submit a required document.
questions.explanation: 'I believe I would be a valuable addition to your team' → Thực tế: 'as an expert fashion designer who also has writing experience' → đã có kinh nghiệm viết. Tuy nhiên đáp án (B): thư viết 'I believe I would be a valuable addition' không nói rõ. Cần đọc kỹ: bà viết blog thời trang → has worked as a writer. → (B)
